d:
Sheikh Hasina wants to return to Bangladesh on December 16, more than two years after fleeing to India. But Dhaka has a warning for the former prime minister: she will be arrested the moment she enters the country.
Hasina faces a death sentence over the 2024 crackdown on student protests that ended her 15-year rule. Meanwhile, Bangladesh is witnessing fresh political violence, attacks on institutions linked to Muhammad Yunus, garment worker protests and growing opposition pressure on Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's government.
